title: CheckpointIndex
description: index.json manifest for a deployed collection of checkpoints (DESIGN.md §14.3, backend/app/cirro.py:_write_viewer_index, frontend/src/data/checkpointIndex.ts). Documented in docs/CHECKPOINT_FORMAT.md.

path.description: Resolved relative to this index.json's own URL.

folder.description: The folder the web app files the checkpoint under on its map.

credit.description: Whose data the checkpoint is made from, under what license, and what was done to it; the web app shows it with the checkpoint.

source.description: The dataset as its publisher titles it.

changes.description: What was done to the data to make the checkpoint.
